text: A campaign needs ten jobs done in order, and most of them call an outside service that can fail.
So it runs as one Cloudflare Workflow, with each job as its own step.
Step two reads recent campaigns, so the next one doesn't repeat them.
Step three searches the web for what's happening locally right now.
Step four, which I wrote, turns a trend into a topical post instead of a sales pitch.
Steps five and six make an image and a short video with AI models, and store them.
Step seven saves one campaign for each store.
Steps eight and nine post it to Instagram, Reels included, and to X.
Step ten records where everything went.
Every finished step saves its result.
When a step fails, it retries on its own, up to two or three times, waiting longer each time.
So if the Instagram post fails, only the Instagram step runs again.
The trend search, the post, the image and the video are not made twice.
For testing, a sandbox mode jumps straight to the media steps and posts nothing.
I reworked most of these steps, from the trend search to the posts.
